release_notes:
Star Soft Enterprise v4.0.68 Release Notes (19-Nov-2026 02:00 PM):
- Floating File Download Card now anchors cleanly right above Team Chat without edge clipping and auto-hides via Policy POL_DOWNLOAD_POPUP_SECONDS (default 8s, configurable 3-120s).
- Manual standalone StarSoft.exe updates and CSV/Snapshot exports now download straight into Desktop\StarSoft_Exports using the unified Download Card without interrupting dialogs.
- Fixed Auto-Update close-without-relaunch race bug (on both Server and Client terminals) via detached --apply-update-wait parent PID exit sync, SingleInstance Mutex retry, and streaming cloud download progress.
